name: caller-principal-python-session-stop-refuses-a-foreign-principal
description: A principal is bound to ONE session: presenting session B's principal on a request naming session A is refused with the FOREIGN error, distinguishable from the absent one (fixture 03), so which phase a caller is in is diagnosable from the refusal. Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: the Coherence-Caller-Principal header is not the caller principal bound to the session_id this request names (caller_principal_foreign)
